Pennsylvania...

CMAMtext: NWS: DUST STORM WARNING til 7:30 PM MDT. Be ready for a sudden drop to zero visibility.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: DUST STORM WARNING for this area until 7:30 PM MDT. Be ready for sudden drop to zero visibility. Pull Aside, Stay Alive! Infants, the elderly and those with respiratory issues urged to take precautions.
